fichas.title: Motorways
fichas.summary: Motorways are roads without adjacent buildings, designed for high-speed vehicles and express transport. Opposing carriageways are separated by a central reservation; each carriageway has two or more lanes and normally a hard shoulder. They are linked by grade-separated intersections and junctions. The page illustrates standard cross-sections, a sign bridge, adjacent building restriction zones, and four-way and three-way interchange forms. Motorways are described as the safest roads and as having the highest capacity; environmental impact is identified as an important design consideration.
